environmentBinding.meaning: EVIDENCE MUST BIND TO THE REVIEWED PRODUCTION ENVIRONMENT / NO ENVIRONMENT CONFIGURED HERE

evidenceStates.meaning: REVIEWED_EVIDENCE_ACCEPTED IS TRANSPORT EVIDENCE ONLY / NOT RELEASE AUTHORITY

failClosedRules: This contract proves no live production HTTPS, TLS, HSTS, security-header or edge-to-origin state by itself.
Localhost, local HTTPS, preview deployments and CI success are not production transport-security evidence.
Transport evidence must bind to the exact reviewed production environment and public-origin authority.
HTTP plaintext handling must be explicitly evidenced rather than inferred.
TLS termination, certificate and protocol evidence must come from the reviewed live ingress or provider authority.
HSTS disposition and any max-age/includeSubDomains/preload values must come from reviewed live evidence; this contract selects none.
Edge-to-origin transport must remain UNVERIFIED until its protection boundary is explicitly classified and evidenced.
Missing, stale, mismatched or UNVERIFIED transport evidence keeps the production release receipt HOLD.
Private keys, certificate private material, provider tokens, credentials and secret values must never appear in evidence receipts or logs.
This contract selects no provider, deployment platform, domain, certificate authority, HSTS value or edge architecture.
